title.narrative: ILO Global Programme on Skills and Life Long Learning 2025-2026

description.narrative:
Norad's contribution through a multi-donor pooled funding mechanism as strategic support to the ILO Global Skills Programme to achieve output 3.2 of the ILO Programme & Budget 2024-25. The goal of the programme is to empower women, men, enterprises and communities to participate and benefit from high- quality, market-relevant, inclusive, lifelong learning, that enables: (a) individual transitions to and between decent jobs; (b) productivity and competitiveness of enterprises in a fast-evolving environment; (c) green and digital transitions and (d) inclusive and peaceful societies.
Direct beneficiaries are those that benefit from skills development interventions provided by Global Skills Programme for improved labour market outcomes; 40 per cent of direct beneficiaries will be women and 10 per cent persons with disabilities. Comprehensive efforts will be directed to make the skills training programmes inclusive through the adaptation of the training venue, equipment, time schedule, curricula and training tools, assessments, peers’ and instructors’ attitudes – as well as targeted support to both women, vulnerable groups and persons with disabilities. The Global Skills Programme will also strive to increase the share of women and persons with disabilities among recipients.
